transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I’ve been having some trouble following what people say sometimes. Like at the museum, someone will be talking right to me about the next art walk, and I’m looking at them, but then I realize I missed the middle of it. I end up having to ask them to say it again.
Do you ever find that your thoughts feel disorganized or that you have trouble keeping track of conversations because your mind seems to jump around?

Not really like my thoughts are all over the place… it’s more that someone will be talking to me, like at the museum about the next art walk, and I’m looking at them, but then I realize I missed part of what they said. Then I have to ask them to run it by me again.
Have you ever heard things that others don’t seem to hear, like voices or sounds that aren’t really there?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Have you ever seen things that others don’t seem to see, like shapes, lights, or images that aren’t really there?
No… I can’t say I’ve seen anything like that. Nothing that seemed not really there.
Have you ever believed something very strongly that others don’t seem to agree with, even after they’ve tried to explain it differently?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I can be stubborn about things sometimes, but not like… believing something nobody else thinks is true after they explain it.
Do you ever find that when you're trying to talk, your words come out in a way that doesn't make sense or is hard for others to follow?
Not really, no. I mean… I might lose my place sometimes, but I don’t think my words come out not making sense. No one’s really told me that.
Have you noticed yourself feeling less motivated or interested in doing things lately, like activities you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I still do the things I usually do. Maybe I’m a little slower to get started sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest.
Have you noticed yourself withdrawing from social situations more than usual, or finding it hard to express emotions like happiness or sadness?
No, I don’t think so. I keep to myself some, but that’s kind of normal for me. I haven’t noticed being more withdrawn or… not feeling things.
Have you noticed any changes in how you express your emotions, like showing less feeling in your face or voice, even when you're feeling something inside?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. I think my face and voice are about the same as usual. If someone else sees it, they haven’t said anything.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts were being put into your head by someone else, taken out, or that others could somehow hear your thoughts?
No… I don’t think so. That sounds pretty unusual. I haven’t felt like anyone was putting thoughts in my head or hearing them.
When you're trying to organize your thoughts or explain something, do you ever feel like your mind is blank or that you can't find the right words to say what you mean?
Not really… I mean, I might lose my train of thought now and then, but I wouldn’t say my mind goes blank or I can’t find words in any major way.
Have you ever experienced moments where things around you seemed unreal, or you felt detached from yourself, like you were watching yourself from outside your body?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had that feeling like I’m outside myself or that things aren’t real.
Have you found it harder lately to start or finish tasks, like chores or projects, even if you know they need to be done?

Yeah… a little. Like with the volunteer group, if they give me a few things to do, I might get the first thing done, like printing maps, but then forget the next call or leave the folders half-finished until someone reminds me.
Have you noticed that your facial expressions or tone of voice have become more flat or less expressive, even when you’re feeling emotions inside?
No… I haven’t really noticed that. I think my face and voice are about the same as usual.
Have you noticed any problems with your work or volunteer responsibilities that are new or worse lately?

Yeah… I guess so. With the museum group, they’ve kind of taken some of the planning stuff off my plate. Not in a big obvious way, but I can tell. And I don’t feel as sure of myself leading the art walks like I used to.
Have you noticed a decrease in your ability to initiate or persist in activities, even ones that you normally find enjoyable or important?

A little, yeah. Mostly with the volunteer stuff. If they give me a few things, I’ll start with one, like printing the maps, and then… I might not get around to calling the museum desk, or I leave the folders half-done until someone reminds me.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost the ability to plan or carry out tasks, like setting goals for the day or completing small projects, even things you used to do easily?

Some, yeah. If they give me a few things to do for the volunteer group, I’ll usually do the first thing, like print the maps. But then I might forget to call the museum desk, or I leave the folders half-done until someone reminds me.
Have you noticed that you’re less able to start or follow through with activities, even things you know are important or used to do without help?

Yeah… I guess that’s fair. Like with the volunteer group, if they give me a few things, I’ll get the first part done—print the maps or whatever—but then I might not make the call to the museum desk, or the folders just sit there half-done until someone reminds me.
Has your ability to handle your responsibilities at the museum or other volunteer work dropped noticeably compared to how you were doing a few months ago?

Yeah… I think it has, somewhat. They’ve sort of moved some of the planning parts away from me at the museum. Nobody made a big thing of it, but I noticed. And I don’t feel as sure leading the art walks like I used to.
